categories.main_business_segments: Anhui Sunhere Pharmaceutical Excipients Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of pharmaceutical excipients. Its product portfolio includes fillers, binders, disintegrants, lubricants, coating materials for oral solid dosage forms, and injectable-grade excipients. The company also serves the health supplement and food industries with some products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced pharmaceutical excipient manufacturing technologies such as spray drying for microcrystalline cellulose and innovative preparation methods for disintegrants like cross-linked sodium carboxymethyl starch. It adheres strictly to pharmaceutical excipient GMP standards and has developed proprietary technologies for polymer film coating materials and enteric water-dispersible coatings. The production process integrates 6S management and lean manufacturing to ensure quality and efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are pharmaceutical formulation manufacturers, including those producing generic and innovative drugs. Secondary markets include health supplement producers and food processing companies. The company also exports products to international markets including Germany, the UK, Italy, Russia, the US, Brazil, Mexico, Australia, India, and the Middle East.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant sales in East China, South China, North and Northeast China, Central China, Southwest and Northwest China. It has a growing overseas market presence accounting for 16% of sales, with exports to multiple countries across Europe, the Americas, Asia, and the Middle East.
categories.supply_chain_position: Anhui Sunhere operates in the upstream segment of the pharmaceutical supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of pharmaceutical excipients, which are critical raw materials used by downstream pharmaceutical formulation companies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on import substitution, product quality optimization, and product line enrichment with differentiated production. R&D priorities include developing high-purity polymer film coating materials, injectable-grade excipients with key quality attributes, multi-specification composite excipients, and water-soluble coating materials. It emphasizes innovation through collaborations with universities and aims to enhance its technological leadership and international competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of pharmaceutical excipients to pharmaceutical manufacturers and related industries. The company also has minor revenue from leasing properties and limited distributor sales. Sales are mostly on a prepaid or bank acceptance basis, with some credit extended to trusted customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in the pharmaceutical excipient industry, especially in oral solid dosage excipients. It holds a top market position in products like microcrystalline cellulose, magnesium stearate, sodium carboxymethyl starch, and hydroxypropyl methylcellulose. It competes mainly with foreign brands and local peers, leveraging its comprehensive product range, quality certifications, and technical service capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 882.57 million, a 5.16% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 119.42 million, a 26.07% decrease mainly due to goodwill impairment. The company maintains steady growth in sales volume and production capacity, with expanding export sales and ongoing investments in production base expansion and R&D facilities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Anhui Sunhere emphasizes high product quality, a broad and diversified product portfolio, and strong technical support services tailored to customer formulation needs. It differentiates itself through advanced manufacturing technologies, multiple international certifications (EXCiPACT, DMF, CEP, HALAL, KOSHER), and active participation in national pharmaceutical excipient standards development. The company’s focus on import substitution and innovation positions it as a trusted partner for pharmaceutical manufacturers seeking reliable, high-performance excipients.
